whatIs: This DevDojo page shows about 40 button designs made with Tailwind, organized into four sections: hover effects, simple, dark and simple in dark mode. Each button has a link to copy its HTML.
It's a good fit when you need a good-looking button that's already done and don't want to install a whole library.
uses: Copying a button with a hover effect for a landing page's call to action.
Choosing a dark variant for a site with dark mode.
Trying a button in a CodePen before bringing it into your project.
caveats: They're only buttons: for other components you'll have to look elsewhere.
The code gets pasted into your project and is designed for Tailwind with JIT mode enabled.
Each button is static HTML; if you want states or behavior you'll have to add them yourself.
pricingNote: The buttons are free to copy; DevDojo promotes Tails, a different product, separately.
idealFor: People who need a Tailwind button ready to copy and paste.
